what_its_for: Molnupiravir is an antiviral medicine used to treat mild to moderate COVID-19 in adults who are at high risk of getting very sick or being hospitalized. It works by stopping the COVID-19 virus from making copies of itself in your body. It is only for people who cannot use other COVID-19 treatments.
how_to_take: Swallow the capsules whole with or without food. Do not crush, chew, or open the capsules. Take all doses as prescribed, even if you start to feel better. Finish the entire 5-day course of treatment.
dosing: The usual dose is 4 capsules (800 mg total) taken twice a day — once in the morning and once in the evening — for 5 days. You should start taking this medicine as soon as possible after your COVID-19 diagnosis, and no later than 5 days after your symptoms begin.
missed_dose: If you miss a dose and it has been less than 10 hours since your scheduled time, take the missed dose as soon as you remember. If it has been more than 10 hours, skip the missed dose and take your next dose at your regularly scheduled time. Do not take two doses at the same time to make up for a missed one.
storage: Store molnupiravir capsules at room temperature between 68°F and 77°F (20°C to 25°C). Keep the capsules in the original container with the lid tightly closed. Keep out of reach of children and pets. Do not use after the expiration date printed on the package.
what_to_avoid: Do not take molnupiravir if you are pregnant or might become pregnant — it can harm an unborn baby. Women who can become pregnant must use reliable birth control during treatment and for 4 days after the last dose. Men who could father a child should use condoms during treatment and for at least 3 months after the last dose. Do not breastfeed while taking this medicine and for 4 days after the last dose. Do not share this medicine with others.
when_to_call_doctor: Call your doctor right away if you experience any of these: worsening or new symptoms of COVID-19 such as difficulty breathing, chest pain, or confusion; signs of an allergic reaction such as rash, itching, swelling of the face or throat, or difficulty breathing; or if you think you may be pregnant while taking this medicine. Also contact your doctor if you have any questions or concerns during your treatment.
when_it_works: Molnupiravir works best when started within 5 days of your COVID-19 symptoms beginning. It will not cure COVID-19 but it can help reduce the chance of being hospitalized or becoming very ill. You should start to feel better during or after the 5-day treatment course. Continue taking all doses even if you feel better sooner.
special_populations: Pregnant women should NOT take this medicine as it may harm the developing baby. It is not approved for use in anyone under 18 years old because it may affect bone and cartilage development in children. Elderly patients and people with kidney or liver problems may still take this medicine, but your doctor will decide if it is right for you. Always tell your doctor about all other medicines, vitamins, and supplements you are taking before starting molnupiravir.
